data.title: 五更琉璃 · 榻榻米间的羞怯撩裙献身
data.description: 静谧的日式卧室地灯昏黄。跪坐在榻榻米上的黑猫满面羞红，双手颤抖着将黑蔷薇哥特长裙慢慢撩起至大腿上方，眼角含泪、断断续续地低语宣告“从现在起……把黑猫变成你的人吧”。
data.location: quiet traditional Japanese bedroom with sliding paper screens
data.action: kneeling on tatami with gothic dress skirt lifted above thighs, face buried in hands with burning crimson blush, murmuring breathless submission to her destiny
data.lighting: warm amber floor lantern casting soft reverent shadows
data.mood: trembling tsundere surrender, profound gap moe, breathless erotic devotion
data.promptProse: Kneeling on tatami in a gothic dress with skirt lifted above bare thighs, Ruri Gokou blushes heavily with trembling breathless devotion.
data.animaCaption: Ruri Gokou kneeling on tatami with lifted skirt in shy romantic surrender.
